WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id as root_id,
        p.id as current_id,
        1 as multiplier
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        pt.multiplier * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_leaf_quantity) as average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(multiplier) as total_leaf_quantity
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE current_id IN (501, 502)
    GROUP BY root_id
)
